senses.definition: A day that is an exact number of years (to the day) since a given significant event occurred. Often preceded by an ordinal number indicating the number of years.
examples: Today is the fiftieth anniversary of the end of the war.

subsenses.definition: (especially) Such a day that commemorates a wedding.
examples: We are celebrating our tenth anniversary today.

senses.definition: (loosely) A day subsequent in time to a given event by some significant period other than a year (especially as prefixed by the amount of time in question).

quotes.text: The occasion was the six-month anniversary of the Aug. 8 coup that brought General Óscar Humberto Mejía Victores to power.
